name: Book of Mages: The Chaotic Period
summary:
Book of Mages: The Chaotic Period is a fantasy role-playing game in which players take on the role of a young mage entering a world divided by rival magical clans. Set in a period of political tension and conflict, the game revolves around six distinct mage clans: Dark Fire, Chaos Fire, Red Fire, Sea Water, Ice Water, and Poison Water. Each clan specializes in its own form of elemental magic, offering different approaches to magical combat.

Players choose a clan, train their character, develop their magical abilities, and compete against other mages in turn-based battles. By challenging rivals and improving their standing in the magical community, players can climb the rankings and pursue the ultimate title of Great Mage.
